rows.label: Resident Evil
rows.hook: pits a heroine against zombies and a sinister corporation, adapted from a Capcom video game

rows.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe
rows.hook: links many superhero movies into one huge connected story, with the Avengers at its center

rows.label: Harry Potter
rows.first_film: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
rows.description: film series of eight fantasy films from 2001–2011 based on the novels of the same name by writer J. K. Rowling
rows.hook: follows a boy wizard and his friends at a magical boarding school, based on novels by J. K. Rowling

rows.label: X-Men
rows.hook: follows mutants with extraordinary powers, led by Professor Charles Xavier and featuring Wolverine

rows.label: Fast & Furious
rows.hook: is known for street racing, heists, and the repeated message that family comes first

rows.label: The Lord of the Rings

rows.first_film: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
